checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: Inspect captured Tower RPC sequence and existing cache/dialog/dispatch patterns; implement pure action planner with safe preconditions; connect background state and popup controls; test key trace transitions and safety stops; build and validate.
checkpointPayload.title: Automate Tower route with saved team and prioritized buffs
